description:
Create a book or document digitization order from a public HTTPS file_url (up to 100 MiB) or a completed multipart upload key (up to 500 MiB).

Accepts PDF, DjVu, ZIP/CBZ page archives, images (JPG/PNG/WebP/TIFF/HEIC/AVIF/BMP/GIF), or Office documents (DOCX/DOC/RTF/ODT/PPTX/PPT/ODP);
kind='book' (default) or kind='document' (A4); optional output_formats subset of epub, fb2, docx, pdf_reader, pdf_clean, pdf, md.
Requires rights_confirmed=true (confirming copyright / permission to digitize). Nothing is charged yet: the book
starts in status splitting while the worker validates the file and counts pages; poll get_book until status is ready
(page_count is now known), then call estimate_book and start_book (mode='sample' for a one-time free probe up to 10
pages or mode='full' for paid full digitization). orthography is auto (default), preserve (pre-1918 Russian: ѣ, і, ѳ),
modernize (convert pre-1918 Russian to modern 1918 spelling) or modern. Reuse idempotency_key when retrying after a
network timeout so the file is not uploaded twice.

file_url.description: Public HTTPS link to a PDF, DjVu (.djvu/.djv), ZIP/CBZ archive of page images, single/multipage image (JPEG, PNG, WebP, TIFF, HEIC, HEIF, AVIF, BMP, GIF), or Office document (DOCX, DOC, RTF, ODT, PPTX, PPT, ODP) up to 100 MiB.
file_url.title: File Url

key.description: Completed upload key from POST /books/uploads/complete (for files up to 500 MiB). Mutually exclusive with file_url.
key.title: Key

kind.description: book = book layout (A5 reader PDF + page-faithful clean PDF, cover, chapters, red-line indentation); document = document layout (A4 clean PDF/DOCX without book cover, preserving requisites and stamps).
kind.title: Kind

mime.description: Optional MIME type (detected automatically from file_url magic bytes or key extension when omitted).
mime.title: Mime

name.description: File name when not obvious from key or file_url.
name.title: Name

orthography.description: auto = detect from book text/sample; preserve = pre-1918 Russian orthography (ѣ, і, ѳ, ъ); modernize = transcribe pre-1918 scan faithfully and convert to modern 1918 Russian spelling; modern = modern spelling.
orthography.title: Orthography

output_formats.description: Optional list of output formats to generate (epub, fb2, docx, pdf_reader, pdf_clean, pdf, md). Defaults to all 7 for kind='book' and ['docx', 'pdf_clean', 'pdf', 'md'] for kind='document'.
output_formats.title: Output Formats

rights_confirmed.description: Must be true: confirms the caller holds copyright / permission to digitize this book.
rights_confirmed.title: Rights Confirmed

name: create_book
